description_en: Queries the endpoint groups associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups接口查询自定义路由类型监听关联的终端节点组
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom routing listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether access logging is enabled. Valid values:

on: Access logging is enabled.

If this parameter is left empty, no filtering is applied and all endpoint groups are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启了访问日志。取值：

  on：已开启访问日志。

该参数为空时，不进行筛选，返回所有终端节点组
parameters.name: access_log_switch

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)

Description.description_en: The description of the endpoint group
Description.description_zh: 终端节点组的描述信息

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupIpList.description_en: The list of outbound public IP addresses of the endpoint group
EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

items.description_en: The list of outbound public IP addresses of the endpoint group
items.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint group
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID

EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_en: The list of new unconfirmed IP addresses of the endpoint group after the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is upgraded
EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组IP列表

items.description_en: The list of new unconfirmed IP addresses of the endpoint group after the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is upgraded
items.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组IP列表

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the custom routing listener

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service provider to which the managed instance belongs.
This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:
true: The instance is a managed instance.
false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that users can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true.
When an instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted and some operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that users can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Creates an instance.
Update: Updates the current instance.
Delete: Deletes the current instance.
Associate: References or is referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanages the instance.
CreateChild: Creates a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener resource

IpSet: acceleration region resource

EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource

ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource

Endpoint: endpoint resource

EndpointGroupDestination: endpoint group protocol mapping resource for a custom routing listener

EndpointPolicy: endpoint access policy resource for a custom routing listener

This parameter is valid only when the Action parameter is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:

true: The managed policy action is managed. Users do not have the permissions to perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance.

false: The managed policy action is not managed. Users can perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：

true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。

false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The state of the endpoint group. Valid values:
init: The endpoint group is being initialized.
active: The endpoint group is running normally.
updating: The endpoint group is being updated.
deleting: The endpoint group is being deleted
State.description_zh:
终端节点组的状态。
init：初始化。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数
